implementation.change: Explicit SPI_BYTES/GPIO_TAIL_REQUIRED policy. Both ordinary ADC1 entries share payload transport and existing parser. GPIO bit is physically sampled, never selected from computed CRC. Legacy callers without outer deadline retain a bounded DRDY+SPI budget; an existing outer deadline is reused.

Physical INTERFACE proof tracks STATUS+CRC8/TIMEOUT0. Covering single/block writes, RESET observation/command, and uncertain/failed restoration invalidate proof. Configure or physical stable snapshot rebuilds it. MUX/PGA writes do not invalidate unrelated INTERFACE proof. REQUIRED checks known recognized ADS1262 identity, not forcedType alone.

Normal Init enables STATUS, then confirms physical snapshot/ID after intentional reset clear before selecting REQUIRED only under explicit board config. Capability failure returns error with no fallback. Legacy no-reset attach cannot prove the required exclusive bus/configuration and returns NOT_SUPPORTED only when the explicit board option is enabled. The old unused PrepareRefPath now keeps STATUS enabled; its analogue routing/reference behavior is unchanged.

Boot qualification uses the same normal FreshChecked policy as runtime; preserves candidate spacing, each-profile 200/800 attempts, 2.5% tolerance, parity counts and no-retry qualification. Source/interface are copied into persistent immutable job result for query. Failed cleanup clears proof.
STD and held controls explicitly select byte-SPI diagnostics even when scientific policy is REQUIRED. TAIL GPIO groups still use explicit GPIO diagnostic API; A/B does not silently become identical.

Full restore failure invalidates driver proof. Fast battery restore verifies INTERFACE in its existing physical core-register read and rebuilds proof only on success. RAILCRC distinguishes actual continuous SPI bytes from physically assembled split bytes; unknown bit/evidence stays unknown. Analog input/reference/calibration/PGA/cache interpretation and rail safety gates are unchanged.

test_coverage.new_scientific_harness: 51 actual-production scenarios, compiled with explicit board option 0 and 1 (102 executions), including both Raw APIs with/without outer deadline, explicit STD overrides, physical last-bit XOR01 injection in both directions, CRC first error plus terminal timeout/config/reset, full/fast restore, actual Bringup identity/capability failure, and RAILCRC maximum-width/unknown provenance.
test_coverage.boot_probe: 20 scenarios each with normal SPI_BYTES and GPIO_REQUIRED plus invalid-coverage configuration; production driver and complete probe.
test_coverage.timing_tail: 25 TIMING + 9 TAIL scenarios + 3 formatter bounds under each scientific policy; complete probe, real Gap wrapper, and driver.
test_coverage.related: Existing driver S3/non-S3, tail256 CRC patterns and lifecycle/admission cases, rail33, presence, battery validity and snapshot-evidence tests all exit0.
test_coverage.limits: GPIO/SPI/DRDY/RTOS are synthetic. Host tests do not demonstrate pad timing, glitch absence, analogue accuracy, actual target stack, or HIL performance.

evidence_boundary.prior_tail_HIL: Root completed tail-probe-02..12 at actual IDF-reported754kHz: STD15/4400 CRC failures, split0/4400, all restored, same boot. Scientific runtime has not yet been tested with this new default policy.
evidence_boundary.timing_confound: Split changes the pause and sampling phase as well as final-bit ownership. Prior diagnostics do not isolate silicon/board root cause; physicalVerified stays0.
evidence_boundary.performance: Prior selected diagnostic records: GPIO readUs182..496, STD158..217, SPI-complete to route-restored11..79us. These are bounded selected records, not full latency distributions. No FPS cap, wait-threshold increase, or slower fixed SPI clock was added.
evidence_boundary.remaining: Root target build and HIL must verify normal VOLT/RES and mixed configurations, battery/rail recovery, fresh data/CRC rates and capture throughput. Scope/physical no-glitch evidence remains unmeasured.

ownership: No main/transport/log encoder changes by ADS worker. Matrix provenance, immutable SPISOURCE query and capability contract handled by identity/root. No target build, flashing, serial, or hardware access by this worker.
